python3 - <<'PY'
import errno
import os
import subprocess

cases = [
    (["--paging=never", "--plain"], b"hello world\r\n"),
    (["--plain", "--paging=never"], b"hello world\r\n"),
    (["--paging=always", "--plain"], b"pager-output\r\n"),
    (["--plain", "--paging=always"], b"pager-output\r\n"),
    (["--paging=always", "-pp"], b"hello world\r\n"),
    (["-pp", "--paging=always"], b"pager-output\r\n"),
]
for args, expected in cases:
    master, slave = os.openpty()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["target/debug/bat", "--no-config", "--color=never", *args, "tests/examples/test.txt"],
            env={**os.environ, "BAT_PAGER": "echo pager-output"},
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=slave, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            timeout=15, check=True,
        )
    finally:
        os.close(slave)
    output = b""
    try:
        while True:
            try:
                chunk = os.read(master, 4096)
            except OSError as error:
                if error.errno != errno.EIO:
                    raise
                break
            if not chunk:
                break
            output += chunk
    finally:
        os.close(master)
    assert output == expected, (args, output, expected)
    assert not result.stderr, (args, result.stderr)
print("Verified six paging/plain combinations with terminal stdout.")
PY
